81.
(1) Notwithstanding anything in any other written
law where the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe
that any organization is engaged in any act amounting to an
offence under this Act, or is acting in a manner prejudicial to
the national security of Sri Lanka or any other country, he
may by order published in the Gazette, (hereinafter referred
to as “Proscription Order”) proscribe such organization in
terms of the provisions of this Act.
